text:
Situation: Ropivacaine hydrochloride has been on FDA's shortage list since 2018-03-23 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is the listed shortage manufacturer with initial posting 2018-03-23. Our inventory across three sites ranges from 8.2 to 28.4 days on hand. The 5 mg/mL 100 mL bag at Corvale East has the lowest coverage at 8.2 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1123748 of Fresenius Kabi USA LLC ended 2020-05-18 and was classified OAI with classification letter dated 2024-05-22. FDA inspection 1174894 ended 2022-06-30 and was classified OAI with classification letter dated 2024-04-30. The 2024-05-22 OAI letter came 2,252 days after FDA first posted the shortage. The Fresenius Kabi label names FEI 1450022 as a registered plant.

Our position: We have an FDA-approved alternate manufacturer for the 5 mg/mL concentration. Anthea Pharma Private Limited's ROPIVACAINE HYDROCHLORIDE 5 mg/mL was approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-06-15. Other potential suppliers (Amneal, Armas, Civica, Gland Pharma) are not on FDA's shortage list today and their labels name no identifiable plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Procure Anthea Pharma Private Limited ROPIVACAINE HYDROCHLORIDE 5 mg/mL — requires pharmacist approval for NDC substitution.
2. Monitor Fresenius Kabi supply allocation and communicate expected delivery dates to all three sites — requires buyer approval.
3. Evaluate allocation of existing 5 mg/mL 20 mL SDV stock (13.4 days at Corvale East) to support 100 mL bag needs — requires pharmacist approval.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Amneal, Armas, Civica, or Gland Pharma without verified supply chain transparency and plant identification.
